title: HiBob pricing - $8-$25/employee/month plus a 10-20% implementation fee
clean_text: HiBob does not publish list pricing; quotes depend on headcount, module selection, and contract length. Reported tiers are Core HR at $8/user/month and Essential at $16/user/month, with Enterprise requiring a custom quote; the broader average cost range is cited as $16-$25 per employee per month. A one-time implementation fee of 10-20% of the first-year contract value applies on top. Based on 65 verified purchases, the median customer pays $36,504/year, with an average 17% discount achievable through negotiation.
